title: Event
description: One JSON event shape for logs, timings, memory, model-load and asset records, emitted by every library through the runtime. Consumed locally (ring buffer, DevTools panel); never sent over the network by any library. Wire format: airplanemode.event/0.1.

session.description: Random id per page load; never persisted, never derived from the user.

source.description: Emitting library or app id: runtime, localdata, glyphsift, pagetriage, dockit or an app id.

name.description: Dotted event name, for example asset.download.progress. Reserved runtime names and their attrs are listed in event.ts (RUNTIME_EVENT_NAMES) and README.md; note that asset.quota's attrs.quota is the browser's storage estimate (or a quotaBytes test override), not the limit the browser enforces.

attrs.description: Flat attributes, at most 32 keys. String values are at most 1024 UTF-16 units. Never URLs with query strings, document text, prompts or user identifiers; the runtime's newEvent() enforces this in code.
